hypothesis: Achromatic hue noise and prematurely frozen kit centres cause avoidable team errors; containment across proposal sources causes duplicate people and incorrect feet.
selection_rule: Development comparison across all available labelled sources, retaining the supervised team classifier for known videos; balance wrong assignments and abstention. No unseen-test claim.
notes: Early candidate diagnostic feature_version strings were stale median_torso_lab_v2 labels. The actual algorithms are described explicitly here; their captured implementation hashes and predictions are retained. Final version is saturation_weighted_hsv_v2.
338 eligible team-labelled crops; recorded TeamTrack keepers and new unknown-identity keepers excluded. Original video keeper metadata is incomplete.
No new weight training; all labels provisional AI visual. Raw snapshot comparison is a post-hoc development example.
